name: booking
description: How to book, what the booking form asks for, and how to make contact

process: Choose check-in and check-out dates on the booking page
Enter guest information, pick an arrival window and accept the Terms and Cancellation Policy
content.is_a_request: The booking form sends a booking request by email. The dates are held only after the host confirms by email; dates already asked for show as Requested on the calendar and stay selectable.

extra_bed.gst: Rates include GST (the Terms state fees are inclusive of 18% GST)

payment_terms_quoted_from_site: To make a booking with bw stays & simply fill in the online reservation form or download the reservation form and call or mail to us. Spaces will be confirmed in order of receipt and upon payment of deposit.

Once your reservation has been confirmed it is necessary to make full payment at least 90 days prior to the tour commencement date. Payment for the tour deposit may be made by Visa, Mastercard, cash deposit, internet banking or International Money Transfer.
Payment for the balance of the tour fee may be made by cash deposit, internet banking or International Money Transfer, Visa or Mastercard.
Fees are quoted in United States dollars or Indian Rupees and are inclusive of the GST (18%)

We regret that personal or bank cheques are not accepted. We reserve the right to cancel your booking if payment is not received when due, wherein the Cancellations and Refunds clause, listed below, shall be effected.

contact.phone_note: The site masks its phone number and its WhatsApp link uses a placeholder-pattern number, so neither is published here. Use email or the booking page.
